verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own ways to get data out: account and treasury statements as PDF downloads (via API and MCP), invoice PDF downloads, and API listing of transactions, customers and invoices. There is no documented bulk 'export everything' feature, no CSV or other open-format account export, and no offboarding or account-closure data portability guidance; API listing endpoints are mostly building blocks rather than an export capability. Missing for 10: bulk export of all account data, documented open/structured export formats such as CSV or JSON, offboarding/portability documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Track your balance - easy access to account level balances, with ability to download statements as PDFs
